transcript.message: Hi! My client needs a tractor to run a loader and a 6-foot rotary mower on 18 acres. The T45 Utility looks like the right fit. We'd like it with the front loader and delivery/setup. Our client isn't in a rush, so we're shopping carefully. We'd offer $43,000 for the package.

Thanks for reaching out. The T45 Utility is a great match for 18 acres with a loader and a 6-foot rotary mower: 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO to run the mower. At list, that package comes to $49,400 ($42,000 tractor, $6,500 loader, $900 delivery and setup). $43,000 is too far below that for me to accept, but I'd like to earn your client's business. I can do the full package delivered and set up for $47,500. So I can put together the best offer for your client, what is their budget or maximum price for this package?

Thanks for coming down to $47,500. I'll keep my client's exact maximum to myself, but I can tell you $47,500 is above what they'd like to spend. They have no deadline, so they can take time to compare options. To meet you partway, I can go to $44,800 for the T45 with the front loader and delivery/setup. That's a firm, ready-to-sign offer for a package that's a clear fit for their 18 acres.

I appreciate you moving up, and I understand your client wants to compare options. The package does fit their 18 acres well. They get a 45 hp 4WD tractor, a quick-attach loader with a 60-inch bucket, and a 540 PTO for the 6-foot mower. It's also delivered, set up, and walked through on site. I can come down again to $46,200 for the full package. That's a meaningful step toward you, and we can get it scheduled as soon as your client signs.

Thanks, I appreciate the move to $46,200. We're getting close. My client's budget is $45,500 for the delivered package, and that's a number I can get approved quickly. If you can do $45,500 for the T45 with the front loader and delivery/setup, we have a deal and can schedule delivery right away.

That works. We have a deal at $45,500 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and delivery/setup. Your client gets a well-matched setup for their 18 acres, delivered, set up, and walked through on site. Payment is due at checkout, and once that's done we'll get delivery on the calendar right away. Thanks for working with us.

transcript.message: Hi, I'm buying on behalf of a client with a 16-acre property who needs to brush hog, move gravel, and do some tilling. Your T45 Utility looks like the right fit. We don't need any add-ons, and my client isn't in a rush. I'd like to open at $33,000 for the T45, tractor only.

Thanks for reaching out. The T45 Utility is a great match for 16 acres of brush hogging, gravel work, and tilling. With 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO, it's built for exactly that. I can't do $33,000, though. That's well below what we can sell it for. I can come down from the $42,000 list to $40,500, tractor only. What's your client's budget or maximum price for this purchase? If I know where you need to land, I can see what works. And since gravel moving is part of the plan, our quick-attach front loader may be worth a look.

Thanks for coming down from list. My client is working with a firm budget in the mid-$30s, and since they're not in a hurry, they'd rather wait for the right number than stretch. We'll pass on the loader; no add-ons needed. I can move up to $34,500 for the T45, tractor only. That's a clean, quick sale for you with no extras to coordinate.

I appreciate the movement and the clear picture of your client's budget. $34,500 is still below where I can sell the T45, but I want to make this work. I can come down to $39,000, tractor only. That's a meaningful drop from list for a machine that will handle brush hogging, gravel, and tilling on 16 acres for years. If your client's budget has any flexibility toward the upper end of their range, let me know and we can try to close the gap.

I appreciate you working with me. $39,000 is still above where my client can go, and with no time pressure they're comfortable waiting. To keep things moving, I can come up to $35,500 for the T45, tractor only. That's a firm, simple deal with no add-ons, delivery, or financing to coordinate.

Thanks for moving up again. I hear you that your client's budget is firm, and I'd like to get this done. I can come down to $37,800 for the T45 Utility, tractor only. That's more than $4,000 off list for a machine that fits your client's 16 acres of brush hogging, gravel, and tilling. If we can meet somewhere close to that, I'm ready to close.

Thanks, that's real movement and I appreciate it. We're getting close. My client's budget really is tight, but to meet you I can stretch to $36,400 for the T45, tractor only. If you can do that, I'm ready to close today.

We really are close, and I appreciate you stretching. I can't go as low as $36,400 on the T45, but I can meet you at $37,000, tractor only. That's $5,000 off list, and I'm ready to close today at that number.
We're nearly there. Let's split the difference and call it done: $36,700 for the T45, tractor only. If that works for you, I'll confirm with my client right away and we can close today.
You've got a deal at $36,700 for the T45 Utility, tractor only. It's a great machine for your client's 16 acres. Go ahead and confirm with them and we'll close today. Payment is due at checkout.
